_note: What the instructor reads when a grade's level is something quoted passages cannot show (BUG-608). One entry per capability in semantic_evidence_scopes.json, in the order they are named. A capability listed under 'subsumes' drops out when the broader one also applies, so a grade is not described twice.

whole_paper_assessment_required.about: the whole paper, such as its tone, how its ideas connect or how often errors appear
whole_paper_assessment_required.check: Read a few pages from different chapters

collection_assessment_required.about: a whole set, such as every reference or every requirement

external_verification_required.about: facts outside the manuscript, such as whether a source is peer-reviewed or certified

caution: Quotes cannot confirm this grade. It is about {about}. {check} before relying on it.
reason: Quotes cannot confirm this rating, so VERIDICAL did not assign it. It is about {about}. {check}, then choose the level.
_later_note: BUG-611, BUG-644: shown at report time on a grade whose stored evidence check said supported before the rule above existed. It never changes the stored decision, score or band, and says it was added after the check. Three variants, chosen by what today's rule (apply_support) would do with the grade: later_note_escalate when the decision policy is not 'decide' (every such grade would go to the instructor), else later_note_adverse when the grade is adverse (lowest level or failed: no low grade is kept on quotes that cannot confirm it), else later_note (kept with a caution).
